title: Docker Compose Starter Kit
shortDescription: Pre-configured Docker Compose setups for common development and production stacks.
longDescription:
Jump-start your containerized applications with this comprehensive Docker Compose starter kit. Each stack includes optimized configurations, health checks, volume management, and networking setup.

Stacks included:
- Node.js + PostgreSQL + Redis
- Python + PostgreSQL + Celery
- WordPress + MySQL + Nginx
- Next.js + PostgreSQL + Redis
- Go + PostgreSQL + Redis
- Monitoring stack (Prometheus + Grafana)

Each stack includes:
- Docker Compose configuration
- Environment variable templates
- Health check configurations
- Volume management setup
- Network isolation
- Development and production variants
